title: SIT inspects Lucknow fire incident site; Congress alleges Uttar Pradesh government’s negligence responsible for tragedy
description: SIT members Amrit Abhijat, Additional Chief Secretary, Tourism and Culture Department, and Praveen Kumar, ADG, Lucknow Zone, conducted a detailed inspection of the entire building for over an hour in the morning; a team from the Uttar Pradesh Forensic Science Laboratory (FSL) also collected crucial evidence from the site
